Name: Better Slime Hutch by glymr (Slime Hutch Expanded - choose Greenhouse or Shed or Cellar or SlimeHutch)
Author: glymr
Description:
The Slime Hutch costs a lot and, before 1.6 the building had a huge footprint, but the sad truth is that raising slimes has never been very profitable and the interior space is small.

This mod changes the Slime Hutch interior into a larger, completely configurable space. It can be a Greenhouse, Shed, Cellar, or larger version of the Slime Hutch. All flooring types, crop layouts, and slime hutch feeders are available in all types of the building. The Greenhouse background even has an additional option for decorating the area [i]outside the window[/i]. This can also be turned into a 'secret' space for extra cask or keg storage. (The far left and right sides are a 'secret' entrance that lets you pass through it!)

There are a huge amount of configuration options, so you'll definitely want to download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod so you can change things in-game. I wrote [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1730]a long article about all the config options[/url], and also a FAQ, so please go to the Articles tab if you want to explore the different options!

If you already have furniture or other items in an existing slime hutch, best practice is to remove everything before adding this mod. I [i]think[/i] living slimes should be okay, but they might possibly get stuck in a wall. ^^; If something isn't working, you can always remove my mod and get your original slime hutch back. Just make sure not to save your game until you're sure it worked okay. Make sure that you don't put your incubator in a zone where slimes can't go, or they may get stuck when they are hatched.

Also, please note: while Slime Hutch Water Spots has now been updated to work with 1.6 (thank you, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/juminos/mods?gameId=1303]junimos[/url]!) sometimes the original water spots may still act as blocked spaces that can't be walked through if the Better Slime Hutch mod is added to a save with an existing slime hutch. I don't know of any way to fix this other than to demolish and rebuild the slime hutch with Better Slime Hutch already installed. :/

Compatibility: This should be compatible with any mod that doesn't change the inside of the Slime Hutch. People have reported issues with Walk of Life: Rebirth IF you decide to get the Slime Siren/Slime Piper profession. WoL adds its own Slime Hutch map that conflicts with Better Slime Hutch. If you don't choose that profession, you shouldn't have any issues. For more info and another possible solution, you can check this comment thread: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19304?tab=posts&comment_id=154779976]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19304?tab=posts&comment_id=154779976[/url]. 

PLEASE let me know if you find any bugs! This is a complicated mod. I tried to test all the features, but I may have missed one or two!

And if you enjoy the mod, pretty please endorse it? It would mean a lot to me. <3

I'm also considering a huge version of this mod with room for tons of trees or crops.  If this is something you'd like to see, please endorse this mod and leave a comment! How many trees and crops would you want it to be able to hold?
